reproduced_source_logic: CapabilityEvidence.__post_init__ validates benchmark_id only as a non-empty bounded identifier; it does not bind benchmark_id to holdout_set_id, source receipt content, fixture family or evaluator lineage.

evaluate_agentic_core requires one record per canonical capability, ACCEPTED source state, unique receipt/reconciliation hashes, threshold compliance, and—when require_shared_holdout_set is true—only equality of the caller-supplied holdout_set_id strings.
evaluate_agentic_core never compares benchmark_id across capability records and never derives holdout_set_id from source receipt/reconciliation content.
Therefore four records can declare four mutually different benchmark_id values while sharing one arbitrary holdout_set_id label and still satisfy every currently encoded family-matching condition.
what_this_proves: The current shared-holdout check is label equality, not provenance-bound shared-family identity.
Current WP807 source cannot mechanically distinguish a genuinely shared underlying fixture family from four unrelated benchmark families that reuse the same holdout_set_id string.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does not show that any canonical accepted WP802-WP805 receipt currently contains mismatched families.
It does not show that an end-to-end canonical WP807 report has been falsely promoted.
It does not grant runtime, model, ARC-AGI-3, GRID10, GWT/J-Space, effect, completion or whole-system credit.

The ChatGPT local container could not clone GitHub because DNS resolution was unavailable; that infrastructure failure is not product evidence and no execution credit is claimed for this counterexample.

architecture_correction.do_not_fix_with: blind benchmark_id equality across all four capabilities, because distinct capability-specific benchmark contracts may legitimately have different benchmark_id values
architecture_correction.minimal_fix: introduce one provenance-bound shared fixture/task-family identity whose digest is derived from or mechanically checked against each exact upstream reconciliation/receipt/run descriptor, then require exact equality of that digest across the four CapabilityEvidence records
architecture_correction.fail_closed_rule: if a capability source cannot prove the common family digest from its admitted evidence, WP807 is NOT_EVALUABLE rather than caller-label-supported
architecture_correction.cross_family_extension: after the inner common-family binding is repaired, the E2 GeneralizationBundleEvidence proposal can evaluate multiple independently bound family digests without weakening the inner four-capability match

counterhypothesis: The canonical upstream receipts may already contain enough exact fixture/run lineage that a future binder can prove shared family identity outside WP807, making this only a missing local enforcement check rather than an exploitable canonical path.
discriminator: Add a repository-hosted negative control that constructs four otherwise-valid CapabilityEvidence records with distinct provenance-bound family digests (or distinct benchmark/fixture lineage where current receipts expose it) but the same text holdout_set_id. The current source should reproduce support; the repaired source must deterministically reject/NOT_EVALUABLE before score evaluation.
